messages:
devon: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild for runtime nodes next week. Found a transitive vuln in libssl that triggers our policy scanner + we want to switch image signing to use KMS-backed keys. Need RBAC and audit guidance.

alice: Thanks, @devon. Can you drop the vuln CVE and which clusters are affected? Also do we want a full rebuild or a +patch rebuild? :thinking_face:

devon: CVE-2024-XXXX, affects prod-runtime-pool and canary-runtime. Patch path exists but we're using trimmed base images so safer to rebuild and reprovision. Goals: minimal privileged service accounts, cosign using customer KMS (cloud-kms://projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/images/keys/cosign), and ensure audit logs for signing + deploy.

sam: For RBAC, we should scope the image-pusher SA to only GCR push + KMS sign. Example minimal IAM bindings (pseudo):
```yaml
- role: roles/storage.objectAdmin
  member: serviceAccount:image-pusher@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner
  member: serviceAccount:image-pusher@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
But we should avoid storage.admin if possible; use objectCreator + objectViewer on the specific bucket.

maya: We also need to tighten the runtime node role. Runtime nodes only need pull and attest verification, not image signing. Suggest node pool SA trimmed to: `roles/storage.objectViewer`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` (for GKE node identity) and optional `roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer` if verifying attestations.

alice: On audit logging: ensure Cloud Audit Logs for KMS Admin/Signer and Container Registry are exported to our long-term audit sink (splunk-audit / security-logs). Add a filter for `methodName: "asymmetricSign"` and `resource.type: "kms_key"` to highlight signing ops.

devon: Good. For the rebuild plan:
1) Build new base image with updated libs + reproducible build steps logged.
2) Sign image with KMS-backed cosign key.
3) Push to staging repo and run attestations + smoke.
4) Canary deploy to canary-runtime, monitor runtime-slo + vuln scanner.
5) Roll out to prod pools.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New image build pipeline triggered by devon at 2024-05-09T14:12:00Z. Pipeline id: pipeline-7642. :gear:

sam: Quick cosign example for KMS-backed signing: 
```bash
export COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood-staging/base:20240509
```
Verification: `cosign verify --key kms://... gcr.io/...`

alice: We'll need an internal playbook entry for incident triage in case signing fails or key rotation is triggered mid-rollout. Add steps: revoke old signatures (if needed), fallback to last-known-good image, and alert SRE + security.

maya: One more infra note — ephemeral builder VMs must not retain KMS key bindings. Use short-lived service account tokens and a dedicated image-pusher SA whose key access is audited.

devon: Can someone own the RBAC deltas and audit sink config? I'll handle build/repro steps.

alice: I can own RBAC delta PR and audit sink filters. Will open RFC + PR today.

sam: I'll add cosign pipeline steps and canary rollout config (timeouts/healthchecks).

security-bot: reminder: create JIRA security-ticket SEC-2024-87 and link to runbook.

devon: Thanks all — created SEC-2024-87 and assigned to @alice. Will post check-in thread once staging pass completes. :thumbsup:
